PPA5500-TE Precision Power Analyzer Transformer Edition
Product catalog summary
Overview: The PPA5500-TE Precision Power Analyzer, Transformer Edition, is designed for high accuracy and reliability in power measurement, particularly at low power factors. It offers a power accuracy of 0.55% at PF=0.01 and a phase accuracy of 0.003°. The device supports a wide range of voltage, current, and frequency, making it suitable for various applications.
Specifications: The analyzer operates from DC to 2MHz with voltage input accuracy of 0.02%+0.02% and current input accuracy of 0.02%+0.02% within specified ranges. It supports 1 to 3 phases and provides detailed phase error and power accuracy metrics across different frequency ranges.
Features: The PPA5500-TE includes functionalities such as corrected power, harmonic and flicker analysis, and various measurement modes (e.g., rms, fundamental, AC, DC). It is equipped with multiple communication ports (RS232, GPIB, LAN, USB) and supports a 24-month calibration interval.
Compliance and Certification: The device is compliant with IEC60076-8 standards and comes with a UKAS ISO17025 certification, ensuring high measurement integrity and traceability.
Customer Feedback: Users appreciate the analyzer for its accuracy at low power factors, competitive pricing, quick calibration turnaround, and excellent after-sales service. The software is noted for its ease of use and flexibility in measurement selection and data recording.
Additional Information: The PPA5500-TE maintains the features and ease of use of the PPA5500 series, with enhancements for low power factor applications. It offers high-resolution measurement displays and free PC software for real-time data analysis.
